name: Restaurant and Bar Hardwood in Seattle: Refinishing Around Service Hours
title-tag: Restaurant & Bar Floor Refinishing in Seattle | Scheduling
meta-description: How Seattle restaurants refinish hardwood without going dark: closed-day recoats, phased sanding, furniture timing, and the maintenance cadence that pays.
post-summary: February 8, 2027 · A bar floor can be renewed inside one closed Monday — waterborne finish recoats in 2–3 hours, and the real constraint is the 48-hour wait before tables return. The three scheduling models for hospitality floors, the recoat cadence that avoids dark weeks entirely, and Seattle-specific notes on old buildings and upstairs neighbors.
